method: Agent desk walkthrough of printed procedures and pieces against the accepted shared rules. State scenarios, not human sessions or browser-engine tests. No duration, enjoyment or balance claim.

cases.name: Setup
cases.setup: Sort all eight ordinary cards; start the five specified shore identities and shuffle the other three.
cases.observation: Five waiting + three in arrival pile = eight unique ordinary identities. Light 6, round 0, completed cycles 0, quest AVAILABLE, empty hand. No PoLong in either ordinary pile.

cases.name: First departure
cases.setup: Board Mother, Child, Merchant, Mason (four seats), all reset to Ship Anger 0. First offer includes Haven; no memory.
cases.observation: Round becomes 1; no spawn; Haven base 0. Deliver Child for no memory and mark CHILD DELIVERED. Other three passengers end at anger 1. Cook stays on shore. No return while passengers remain.

cases.name: Round-three spawn with full boat
cases.setup: Four ordinary seats occupied before the third outward round; no Passage ending the boat.
cases.observation: Round 3 adds a separate zero-seat PoLong before fog. It starts anger 0 and adds zero fog. No passenger is ejected; after retained-passenger anger it is at 1.

cases.name: Foresight staged
cases.setup: Prepare current, next and next+1 pairs on six opaque slips; play Merchant Foresight.
cases.observation: All six offers become visible. They stay visible for the cycle; already seen choices are copied to an extendable visible ledger before slips are reused. No route order is prescribed.

cases.name: Foresight missing input
cases.setup: Only two pairs are supplied; player proposes Foresight.
cases.observation: Pause for the facilitator's third pair before consuming the memory or changing the round. No invented map-end penalty.

cases.name: Optional matching delivery
cases.setup: At River Styx, Merchant and Soldier are matching passengers. Choose Merchant only.
cases.observation: Merchant enters resolved discard and gives its own Foresight. Soldier may remain, then gains anger. Delivery restores no Light.

cases.name: Resolved-soul recycling
cases.setup: After return, shore has two ordinary souls; arrival pile has one; resolved discard has five. Refill.
cases.observation: Draw the one arrival, then shuffle resolved ordinary souls and draw two to reach five waiting. Three remain in arrival pile. Active souls are excluded; new arrivals are anger 0 and miss the already-resolved increment.

cases.name: Repeated reward with older copies held
cases.setup: Hand has Merchant memory copies 01-03. Recycled Merchant qualifies again.
cases.observation: Supply copy 04. Player chooses one excess card to return to that source reserve. No held copy is confiscated before the reward choice. Four copies suffice.

cases.name: Different-source simultaneous rewards
cases.setup: Hand has three cards; Merchant and Soldier both deliver at Styx.
cases.observation: Each has a separate reserve and at most one new reward per source. Choose excess cards to return until hand is three. Neither reserve imposes a game limit.

cases.name: Calm changes PoLong fog
cases.setup: Two instances at anger 2 and 3; Calm targets the first; Haven crossing with enough Light.
cases.observation: Anger becomes 1 and 3 before travel: added fog is 0+1. After crossing they become 2 and 4; the second costs one Light and leaves. No ongoing wraith fog remains.

cases.name: Simultaneous expiries and Guard
cases.setup: Light 2; three remaining passengers reach anger 4; Guard still unused because crossing fog was 0.
cases.observation: Guard prevents the first one-point loss. Second expiry reduces Light to 1. Third reduces it to 0 and ends the run. No later recovery or reward rescue.

cases.name: Quest success across cycles
cases.setup: CHILD DELIVERED was recorded in an earlier cycle. Deliver Mother to Tartarus.
cases.observation: Receive one Mother Light and one Passage; resolve overflow; mark COMPLETED. Recycled later deliveries give only ordinary fixed rewards. Passage is never re-earned this run.

cases.name: Quest failure persists
cases.setup: Mother delivers before Child qualifies, or a still-required family member expires.
cases.observation: Mark FAILED. Recycling does not allow another attempt. An already qualifying Child's later recycled loss does not erase CHILD DELIVERED.

cases.name: Passage empties boat
cases.setup: Only Poet aboard; Passage played before a scheduled spawn round.
cases.observation: Poet instantly delivers, gives Foresight, and empties boat. Round does not advance; no PoLong spawns; return uses the same already-used memory allowance. Newly gained Foresight cannot be used on that immediate return.

cases.name: Passage targets PoLong
cases.setup: PoLong is an onboard target for Passage.
cases.observation: Remove that instance with no ordinary memory, travel fog, anger advance or round increment. If the boat becomes empty, immediate return uses the spent allowance.

cases.name: Shore expiry before healing
cases.setup: Light 1; one waiting soul at Shore Anger 1. Resolve return without Guard, then compare Guard case.
cases.observation: Without Guard: anger reaches 2, Light reaches 0, run stops before recovery. With Guard: loss prevented, soul resolved, Light then recovers from 1 to 3.

cases.name: Global cadence across cycles
cases.setup: Finish a cycle with global round 2. Return and board again.
cases.observation: Return and boarding leave total at 2. Next crossing is round 3 and spawns. Written totals extend on paper; no cycle or track endpoint ends play.

cases.name: Reset and reuse
cases.setup: End voluntarily or at zero Light, record the reason and sort every piece.
cases.observation: All held/spent memories return to source reserves; ordinary identities return to the prescribed initial shore/arrival split; PoLong state clears; quest AVAILABLE, round 0, completed cycles 0, Light 6. Extra sheets extend logs, not game rules.
